name: ModelInfoLabel
title: ModelInfo Label
description: Specifies the label for the class constructed in the model info for the profile (i.e. an alternative, user-friendly name that can be used as the identifier for the class in CQL expressions).
purpose: An artifact author must be able to control the labels applied to classes in the model info.

element.short: What label to use for the class
element.definition: Specifies the label to be used for the class constructed for the profile (i.e. an alternative user-friendly name that can be used to identify the class in CQL).
